title: TrustLens Detection Result (P3-WP1 runtime contract)
description: Phase 3 DET-001. The RUNTIME output contract for ONE TrustLens evaluation: what TrustLens concluded, how strongly, why, and under exactly which pinned knowledge, such that the decision is fully reproducible and fully explainable. Promoted and frozen from the Phase-3 design copy at P3-WP1; the design copy is superseded by this file. This contract fixes the SHAPE the deterministic engine (later work packages) must produce; it contains NO detection logic. The five decision quantities are SEPARATE fields (input_support_status, classification, decision_severity, matched_evidence_strength, risk_level, detection_confidence) and are NEVER collapsed into one number or a probability (CONF-001, glossary section 1). input_support_status is decided BEFORE classification; UNSUPPORTED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / ERROR are NEVER mapped to a benign outcome (DET-001 section 3; UNKNOWN is not SAFE). additionalProperties:false at every level structurally forbids a smuggled probability/score field; the runtime validator adds a name-scan as defence in depth. API-neutral JSON Schema (STEP 17); privacy-minimised — it carries observation/evidence REFERENCES, not raw credential content (STEP 18).

corroboration.description: STEP 8 / DET-001 section 13. Corroboration measured over INDEPENDENT evidence classes/families, NOT rule count. Five rules off one URL keyword corroborate weakly; five independent observations corroborate strongly. WP1 defines the shape only; P3-WP5 computes it.

shared_observation_refs.description: Observation ids shared across multiple fired rules — so shared evidence is not mistaken for independent corroboration (STEP 8).

explanation.description: STEP 6 / DET-001 section 13. Structured FIRST; optional human-readable text is DERIVED from these fields. Every field is derived from runtime facts + the fired rules' stored explanation/evidence; no unsupported factual claim may appear (explanation-provenance constraint). Official facts live only in evidence_basis quotes.

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary, derived from the structured fields.

supporting_observations.description: The exact observations/spans that supported the finding — references + optional REDACTED excerpt, never raw credential content (STEP 18).

redacted_quote.description: Optional short excerpt with PII masked. MUST be redacted; raw OTP/PAN/UPI/phone must not appear.

suppression_considered.description: Each suppressor and whether it applied or was blocked by an override, and why.

evidence_basis.description: Official citations behind the fired rules — the ONLY facts the narrative may assert.

detection_confidence_reason.description: Operational meaning of the confidence band for this decision (DET-001 section 9).

recommendedAction.description: STEP 7. Structured, governed action. Each action MUST trace to a fired rule / active override / matched family (DET-001 section 14); no free-form generated advice may enter the deterministic contract.

evaluationError.description: STEP 10. Fail-closed diagnostic. scope=WHOLE_EVALUATION accompanies input_support_status=ERROR (the engine refused to evaluate); scope=SINGLE_RULE accompanies degraded=true (evaluation continued, one rule unavailable). Neither may serialize as NO_SCAM_PATTERN.

result_contract_version.description: Version of THIS runtime result contract. Semantic versioning per KB-001 section 8: PATCH = clarification with no interpretation change; MINOR = backwards-compatible additive field; MAJOR = any backwards-incompatible interpretation change (a removed/renamed field, a tightened enum, or a changed meaning). const per contract revision.

engine_version.description: Optional top-level echo of provenance.engine_version for quick access; the authoritative copy is in provenance.

evaluation_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant of evaluation. Provenance only; not an input to any decision quantity.

input_support_status.description: DET-001 section 3, decided FIRST. None of these maps to LOW RISK automatically; UNKNOWN is not SAFE.

classification.description: DET-001 section 4 — what TrustLens CONCLUDES, distinct from severity. Cross-field consistency (e.g. UNSUPPORTED input -> UNSUPPORTED classification; ERROR never 'safe') is enforced by the runtime validator, not by JSON Schema alone.

decision_severity.description: Highest EFFECTIVE severity among fired rules (harm IF the pattern is genuine). Ordinal, never numeric. NONE when no rule fires.

matched_evidence_strength.description: Strength of the matched evidence behind the governing rule. Feeds risk_level; distinct from detection_confidence (glossary section 1).

risk_level.description: Ordinal lookup of (decision_severity x matched_evidence_strength) per the ADR-0006 risk matrix. Bounded, decomposable, reproducible; user-visible as a band. NOT a probability, NOT a percentage, and independent of detection_confidence (never averaged in).

detection_confidence.description: DET-001 section 9 — trust in TrustLens's own analysis of THIS submission. Categorical. NOT a calibrated fraud probability. NOT_APPLICABLE when no rule fires or input is UNSUPPORTED/ERROR.

provenance.description: STEP 9 / DET-001 section 16 — everything that affects the output, pinned. Same (observations + bundle + engine_version + evaluation_profile) MUST yield an identical result. Compatible with the ADR-0004 bundle manifest (component_versions mirror bundle-manifest.schema.json). commit_sha alone is NOT sufficient (STEP 9).

bundle_content_digest.description: SHA-256 content digest of the published knowledge bundle (ADR-0004). Answers 'which knowledge executed'.

component_versions.description: Pinned versions of every knowledge component consulted (STEP 9). Names mirror bundle-manifest.schema.json.

matched_rules.description: Convenience summary: ids of rules whose evaluation_state=MATCHED. rule_results carries the full per-rule objects.

rule_results.description: One entry per rule that MATCHED, was SUPPRESSED, or came out INDETERMINATE (or NOT_APPLICABLE due to a per-rule error). NOT_MATCHED rules may be omitted; INDETERMINATE ones must be kept.

ambiguities.description: Decisive observations that were AMBIGUOUS, e.g. payment direction unresolved (DET-001 sections 12/15).

limitations.description: e.g. synthetic-only validation, no accuracy claim (G-09), capped PARTIAL evidence.

degraded.description: True if a per-rule error occurred but evaluation continued; caps confidence and routes to review (DET-001 section 16).

errors.description: Fail-closed diagnostics. WHOLE_EVALUATION errors accompany input_support_status=ERROR; SINGLE_RULE errors accompany degraded=true. Never serialize a failure as NO_SCAM_PATTERN.
